description: This Java source file defines List15, an Android ListActivity demonstrating multiple selection modes with contextual action bar, including handling user actions on selected items.

classes.name: List15
classes.description: An Android ListActivity demonstrating multi-choice selection with contextual action bar.

classes.name: List15.ModeCallback
classes.description: Inner class implementing MultiChoiceModeListener to handle selection mode callbacks.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the ListView, sets choice mode to multiple modal, and attaches a multi-choice mode listener.

methods.name: onPostCreate
methods.description: Sets the subtitle of the ActionBar to guide the user to long press for selection.

methods.name: ModeCallback.onCreateActionMode
methods.description: Inflates the contextual menu and sets the title for selection mode.

methods.name: ModeCallback.onPrepareActionMode
methods.description: Prepares the action mode; returns true indicating the menu is ready.

methods.name: ModeCallback.onActionItemClicked
methods.description: Handles clicks on action menu items, such as sharing selected items or other actions.

methods.name: ModeCallback.onDestroyActionMode
methods.description: Cleans up when the action mode is finished; currently empty.

methods.name: ModeCallback.onItemCheckedStateChanged
methods.description: Updates the subtitle with the count of selected items when selection changes.

methods.name: setSubtitle
methods.description: Sets the subtitle of the action mode based on how many items are selected.
